measures.id: Bay Area Transportation Authority Millage Proposal
measures.title: Bay Area Transportation Authority Millage Renewal
measures.summary: Would let the Bay Area Transportation Authority for Grand Traverse and Leelanau Counties levy up to 0.4589 mill ($0.46 per $1,000 of taxable value) each year for seven years, 2028 through 2034. This renews a 0.4788 mill levy that the Headlee Amendment reduced to 0.4589 mill. The money funds public transportation capital and operating costs and transportation for seniors and people with disabilities, with an estimated $6,041,755 in the first year, part of which local development and brownfield authorities capture.
measures.yesMeans: The Bay Area Transportation Authority could continue levying up to 0.4589 mill from 2028 through 2034.
measures.noMeans: The Bay Area Transportation Authority could not levy this renewal millage.
